name: agentic-hq
description: Agentic HQ - Orchestrating agentic software development teams

scripts.// POSTINSTALL: FIX: node-pty posix_spawnp failed on macOS. pnpm extracts spawn-helper binary with -rw-r--r-- instead of -rwxr-xr-x. Known pnpm bug: https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/issues/7366. Mac-only (darwin-*), fails silently on other platforms.
scripts.// VALIDATION: validate = typecheck + lint + format + unit tests (REQUIRED before commits)
scripts.validate: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm test
scripts.validate:all: pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm test:all
scripts.// DEMO: STRING REVERSAL: Two ways to run the string reversal demo (override the default string with -- --string-to-reverse='your string')
scripts.// demo:agentic-hq-cli: Uses 'node bin/agentic-hq.cjs' directly — self-contained, no global PATH dependency (same as the e2e test)
scripts.demo:agentic-hq-cli:string-reversal: node bin/agentic-hq.cjs --workflow-command-supplier=/agentic-hq-demos-plugin:string-reversal -- --string-to-reverse='this is a demo string'
scripts.// demo:plugin-direct: Runs the EXACT command the skill returns (cd + pnpm install + pnpm demo:string-reversal), bypassing the agentic-hq CLI
scripts.demo:plugin-direct:string-reversal: bash -c "cd .agentic-hq/plugins/agentic-hq-demos-plugin/skills/string-reversal/ts-workflow && pnpm install --ignore-workspace && pnpm demo:string-reversal --string-to-reverse='this is a demo string'"
scripts.// TEST COMMANDS: test = unit tests, test:unit = same as test, test:all = unit + integration + e2e
scripts.test:all: pnpm test && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:demo-quick-jira-workflow:expect: vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/demo/quick-jira-workflow-produces-expected-files.e2e.test.ts -t 'should implement a test Jira and produce expected files'
scripts.test:e2e:demo-quick-jira-workflow:manual:
printf '
🔴 WARNING: This test modifies your REAL project workspace and you will have to manually revert the changes yourself! 🔴
Press Enter to continue or Ctrl+C to abort...

' && read -p '' && RUN_DISABLED_MANUAL_E2E=true vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts tests/e2e/demo/quick-jira-workflow-produces-expected-files.e2e.test.ts -t 'should use git directory when project-root not provided'
scripts.// WATCH MODE DISABLED: Watch mode causes AI test execution to hang
